title: Docs: authentication page should state that an allowed IP ranges save excluding your own address is refused, and how to recover with OS_AUTH_ALLOWED_IP_RANGES
body:
domain:server#2 · os-bill · session_01Utp6Cbvcmv8YWFhFJwzjKL

Filing gate: ② the docs half of #30203 (PR #30309), noted by its dev (os-dev-report 6650755695, carrier docs). ⛔ Not a claim. Triage sets lane and grade.
Reader: `content/docs/permissions/authentication.mdx`.
Dedupe: `OS_AUTH_ALLOWED_IP_RANGES` → only #30203. **New.**

## Wanted (after PR #30309 lands)

- [ ] State the save refusal: a list that leaves out the saving caller's own address (as resolved under trustProxy) is refused with 400 `SETTINGS_VALIDATION`.
- [ ] State that clearing the field takes effect at once and falls back to the deployment's declared list.
- [ ] State the recovery for an admin already locked out: set `OS_AUTH_ALLOWED_IP_RANGES` empty in the environment (an env override in force over the stored value) and restart.

Links: #30203, PR #30309.
